units.source_text: 老夫人的法事，概由夕雾一手包办。

en.t: Yugiri took full responsibility for arranging the old lady's memorial service.

units.source_text: 种种消息，自然不能隐讳，前太政大臣也闻知了。

en.t: Naturally, the various reports could not be kept hidden, and the former Chancellor also heard about them.

units.source_text: 他认为夕雾不会如此存心，总是女的思虑浅率之故。

en.t: He believed that Yugiri could not have intended such a thing, and that it must simply have been due to the woman's shallow judgment.

units.source_text: 举办法事之日，柏木诸弟因有旧情，都来吊奠。

en.t: On the day of the memorial service, Kashiwagi's younger brothers all came to pay their respects, moved by their old ties.

units.source_text: 前太政大臣亦致送隆仪，以供诵经布施。

en.t: The former Chancellor also sent generous offerings to be used for the sutra recitations and alms.

units.source_text: 所有供养，皆极丰盛，仪式之体面并不逊于当时得势之家。

en.t: All the offerings were exceedingly lavish, and the dignity of the ceremony was in no way inferior to that of any powerful house of the time.
